source.label: Reviewed Garmin FIT activity record stream
filters: All 12,851 decoded record messages are retained in ride_series.
Race Tape effort rule: raw power strictly greater than 220 W for at least 16 consecutive recorded seconds within one uninterrupted recording segment.
Exact 220 W, missing power, and qualifying runs of 15 seconds or fewer are Between-effort samples.
No bridging, smoothing, or clock-time fields are used in segmentation.
caveats: Effort is an authored descriptive label, not a physiological diagnosis or a Garmin/TrainingPeaks interval type.
Between-effort segments can contain short raw-power bursts above 220 W; they failed the 16-consecutive-second rule.
Two missing power samples occur at auto-pause resumes and are treated as non-effort for classification while remaining null in reviewed rows.
Active race positions are sample-based and deliberately omit absolute clock times.

metricDefinitions.label: Effort sample
metricDefinitions.definition: A record belonging to a raw-power run strictly above 220 W for at least 16 consecutive recorded seconds within one uninterrupted recording segment.

metricDefinitions.label: Between-effort sample
metricDefinitions.definition: Any retained record not classified as Effort, including exact-220 W samples, missing power, and >220 W runs lasting 15 seconds or less.

metricDefinitions.label: Power-to-weight
metricDefinitions.definition: Measured power divided by the rider's stated current weight of 68.0388555 kg (150 lb).

metricDefinitions.label: Active position
metricDefinitions.definition: Zero-based position in the complete ordered record stream; auto-pause gaps contain no interpolated records.

metricDefinitions.label: Course section
metricDefinitions.definition: Rollout for active_s <252; Loop 1 for 252-6261; Loop 2 for 6262-12544; Finish from12545 onward.

evidenceFlow.title: CRC and decoder validation
evidenceFlow.detail: Garmin FIT SDK decoded with CRC checking and no errors; fitdecode independently verified header and trailing CRCs.

evidenceFlow.title: Strict Race Tape segmentation
evidenceFlow.detail: Raw >220 W runs were split at recording gaps, accepted only at 16 or more consecutive samples, and run-length encoded with their exact complement.

methods.code: Decode all FIT record messages; sort by timestamp; preserve every record; derive active sample position, strict effort membership, lap membership, course section, W/kg, and pause markers without exposing wall-clock timestamps.
